newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica inflation 1.34 percent in April.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica inflation 1.34 percent in April.

text.p: Cost Rica's consumer price index rose 1.34 percent in April, compared to a rise of 0.56 percent in March, the government said Tuesday.

The main factors in the increase were rises in prices of bus and taxi services, dental visits, cigarettes, coffee prices, potatoes and meat, Finance Minister Jose Leon Desanti said at a news conference.
Inflation from January to April was 5.21 percent, compared to 3.65 percent in the same period a year earlier, he said.
From April 1996 to April this year, inflation was 14.91 percent.
